text:
Aisha (Design): dropped updated compact trace toolbar — aiming for lower height and clearer affordances. mock: https://imgur.com/compact2

Tom - Eng: looks fine. quick constraints: touch targets >=44px, and avoid reflow on hover.

Riley PM: Support request: exporting should allow 'selection' vs 'full' and include trace permalink in metadata.

Nina Support: +1 for selection. Also need a quick copy that pastes trace id + link in one paste. saves time in tickets.

Aisha (Design): proposal: show short correlation pill with inline copy icon on desktop. on click open mini menu: Copy short / Copy full / Copy + permalink. mobile: pill opens sheet with same options.

accessibility-bot: Keyboard flows: pill must be focusable (tab), Enter opens menu, Arrow keys navigate, Esc closes. Copy actions should announce success via aria-live="polite".

Tom - Eng: implementation note: we'll implement copy variants server-side? better to construct in client and include permalink. cheap to do on click.

Aisha (Design): export label options: we considered "Download trace (.har)" vs "Export trace snapshot (.har)". leaning to "Download trace snapshot (.har)" for clarity. thoughts?

Riley PM: "Export trace (.har)" matches other consoles, but clarity wins. fine with Aisha's wording.

Nina Support: please include an option to also download trace.json — many customers debug with JSON. UI could put a small chevron next to main action.

Tom - Eng: will implement primary HAR and a small chevron that opens JSON variant. good.

Aisha (Design): play/pause in compact = icon-only with aria-label "Play trace" / "Pause trace". timestamp readout should use aria-live="polite" and be throttled.

accessibility-bot: Throttle announcements (250ms) and ensure time reads like "0 minutes 12 seconds" for SR clarity.

Tom - Eng: will throttle and format time verbally. also add keyboard shortcut K for toggle; arrows for small steps, Shift+arrows for larger jumps.

Riley PM: show a tiny keyboard hint on hover of play button and list all shortcuts in the settings modal.

Aisha (Design): inline "Copy stack" button next to collapsed frames? support likes that. might be noisy though.

Nina Support: inline copy is helpful. make it subtle (link-style) and with aria-label "Copy stack as text".

Tom - Eng: ok. for long traces we'll virtualize ticks so scrubber remains smooth.

deploybot: Preview build deployed to https://redwood-inference.dev/trace-preview/1975554321 (expires in 24h)

Aisha (Design): thanks — I'll update the mock per decisions and add a small a11y checklist. pairing review at 2:30?

Tom - Eng: I can join.

Riley PM: same.

Nina Support: will try to make it.

accessibility-bot: Reminder: ensure contrast ratios >=4.5:1 for icon labels and focus rings visible.

Aisha (Design): noted, closing thread — will post final frames after the review. :white_check_mark:
